source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1964: polled 4 June 1964 in Lurgan and Crossmaglen; the other 18 divisions (19 seats) returned unopposed. The nominations list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. T. Hutchinson: no party label printed in 1964. At other elections he stood as Independent (Tandragee, Tandragee Urban District, 17 May 1961, printed 'all independents': Portadown Times, 5 May 1961, p. 24 ("No contest in Tandragee"); Tandragee, Tandragee Urban District, 20 May 1964, listed as Independent: Portadown Times, 22 May 1964, p. 11 ("Shocks in Tandragee election"); Tandragee, Tandragee Urban District, 17 May 1967, listed as Independent: Portadown News, 19 May 1967, p. 3 ("McKillop loses seat in Tandragee")).
